easy_fields.name: Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD)
easy_fields.creator: Blaine Hoak, Patrick McDaniel
easy_fields.citeAs: Hoak, B., & McDaniel, P. (2025). On Synthetic Texture Datasets: Challenges, Creation, and Curation. arXiv:2409.10297v3.
easy_fields.description: The Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD) is a new synthetic texture dataset comprising 246,285 images across 56 texture classes. It was created using an extensible methodology for generating high-quality, diverse texture images via text-to-image models. PTD is designed to support texture-based research, including understanding model biases and identifying security vulnerabilities.

G3_collection.reasoning: The paper extensively details the methodology for generating the synthetic dataset, including prompt creation, the use of Stable Diffusion, and the number of images generated per prompt.

G4_annotation.reasoning: The dataset is generated from descriptive text prompts, which serve as inherent annotations, and the paper includes a human evaluation study where participants rated image quality and representativeness against these descriptors.

G5_rai.reasoning: The paper explicitly discusses texture bias, limitations of existing datasets, and details issues with safety filters flagging benign texture images, dedicating a full section to using the dataset for measuring texture bias.
